title: Named thresholds
goal: The thresholds were given names (pass, top) and the top grade now adds 1 to the first grade. Keep that, but make the result the same as the old version again.

keep.desc: the thresholds stay named: int pass = 60 and int top = pass + 30
the tests use the names, not the numbers 60 or 90
the top grade still adds 1: g = g + 1
